title: Contract field table
responsibility: Display typed contract fields and examples with accessible detail controls.

inputs.name: ContractTable.group
inputs.description: Named parameter, return or component fields with types and authored or illustrative examples.

inputs.name: ContractTable.plain
inputs.description: Optional compact labels beneath a callable heading.

inputs.name: ContractTable.onexample
inputs.description: Open the existing example modal and retain its focus return target.

outputs.name: ContractTable
outputs.description: A field table with unbroken names and types, clipped long examples and keyboard-accessible detail controls; wider tables scroll within their frame and return tables omit names.
